excerpt.zh: 我们的情报分析师将潜在目标的表单合并到一块之后，我们的独行特工开始渗透[target.GetName]。
excerpt.en: As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的情报分析师将潜在目标的表单合并到一块之后，我们的独行特工开始渗透[target.GetName]。
texts.en: As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的特工现在正在渗透[target.GetName]，但是他们必须额外小心，以免引起帝国安全总局的注意。我们的情报分析师已经把潜在目标的表单合并到了一起。
texts.en: Our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName], but great care must be taken to avoid drawing the attention of the Imperial Security Directorate. A list of potential targets is being put together by our intelligence analysts.
